segments.name: Tanker Segment
products: crude oil and oil products transportation services
segments.description: Transports crude oil and oil products by tanker, chartering vessels to charterers on time charter terms.
segments.evidence: Following the acquisition of M/Y Para Bellvm on April 11, 2025, we determined that we operate in two reportable segments: (i) the tanker segment and (ii) the megayacht segment.

segments.name: Megayacht Segment
segments.description: Charters the megayacht M/Y Para Bellvm, providing recreational transportation services to charterers.
segments.evidence: Time charter revenue for the megayacht segment is generated since the acquisition of M/Y Para Bellvm on April 11, 2025, and relates to revenues from the chartering of the respective megayacht.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay time charter hire to the company for chartering its tanker vessels and the megayacht M/Y Para Bellvm.
revenueModel.evidence: Time charter revenue for the megayacht segment is generated since the acquisition of M/Y Para Bellvm on April 11, 2025, and relates to revenues from the chartering of the respective megayacht.

changes.text: In 2025 the company added a megayacht segment after acquiring M/Y Para Bellvm, alongside its tanker segment.
changes.evidence: We entered the megayacht business on April 11, 2025, and, accordingly, no comparative financial information exists for the year ended December 31, 2024.

changes.text: In 2025 tanker vessels M/T Eco West Coast and M/T Eco Malibu left the company in a spin-off.
changes.evidence: The consummation of the spin-off on August 1, 2025, that resulted in M/T Eco West Coast and M/T Eco Malibu leaving the Company
